about: The opening's song, as it is to be sung over the finished picture by a model that sings: built on her hook, 'Squish Sloppy~♡', with action and rhyme in the words, in a sound that belongs to the bright, cute, comic picture. The times are where each part should fall on the picture (120 beats a minute, a bar is two seconds). The takes themselves sang other words (each shot's 'lyric' in opening.json); these are for the films with the song laid over.
title: Squish Sloppy~♡
style: High-energy anime opening theme, J-rock and J-pop, 120 BPM in 4/4 with a driving double-time feel: pounding drums, fast electric guitars, bass, bright synth stabs. Urgent, punchy verses; a big anthemic chorus with gang shouts on the hook 'Squish, Sloppy!'; the feeling of a fight about to start. Lead vocal: a cute, high, youthful anime-girl singing voice, smug, bratty and teasing, sing-song but forceful, with real pitch and energy. Sung in English. No long intro: the voice comes in within six seconds. About ninety seconds, ending on a hard final hit right after the last word.

shades.cute: Hyper, bright, bouncy anime-opening idol pop with denpa energy, 120 BPM in 4/4: quick sparkling synths, chiptune blips, handclaps, a punchy four-on-the-floor kick, slap bass, and a crowd shouting back the hook 'Squish, Sloppy!'. Cute but cocky: quick teasing verses, a huge sing-along chorus with real punch. Lead vocal: a kawaii anime character-song voice: a very high-pitched, light, bright, cute girl's singing voice, a little squeaky, like a small mascot catgirl; bratty, teasing, smug and sing-song, sung with a smirk. Never a mature, deep, husky or belting voice. Sung in English. A short instrumental intro of about five seconds with one shouted 'Sloppy!', then straight into the verse; a clean final hit at the end. About ninety seconds.
shades.poprock: Bright, fast anime-opening pop-rock, 120 BPM in 4/4: crunchy rhythm guitars and live drums under sparkling synths and handclaps, bouncy bass, and a crowd shouting back the hook 'Squish, Sloppy!'. Cute and cocky with punch: teasing verses, an anthemic sing-along chorus. Lead vocal: a kawaii anime character-song voice: a very high-pitched, light, bright, cute girl's singing voice, a little squeaky, like a small mascot catgirl; bratty, teasing, smug and sing-song, sung with a smirk. Never a mature, deep, husky or belting voice. Sung in English. A short instrumental intro of about five seconds with one shouted 'Sloppy!', then straight into the verse; a clean final hit at the end. About ninety seconds.

Lead vocal: a kawaii anime character-song voice: a very high-pitched, light, bright, cute girl's singing voice, a little squeaky, like a small mascot catgirl; bratty, teasing, smug and sing-song. Never a mature, deep, husky or belting voice. Sung in English. A short intro, a clean ending, about ninety seconds.
